spec.title: Connection Status
spec.description: SELECT last("value") FROM "fritzbox_value" WHERE ("type_instance" = 'constatus') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval)

spec.query: SELECT value FROM "fritzbox_value" WHERE ("type_instance" = 'constatus') AND time > now() - 25s LIMIT 1
